svg.title: Reciprocation trajectories: Dood, Leven, Zweven
svg.desc: Three small panels of the asymmetry A = hᵢ − hⱼ, the gap between how much each side of a Koppel is reciprocating, over a stretch of the bond’s life (Sections VI and VIII.4 of the Speelgoed). Dood (λ > 0): the gap closes, then holds at a fixed nonzero offset A*, permanently. Leven (λ crosses zero): the gap runs through parity and settles on the opposite sign; Eigen and Echo swap sides. Zweven (λ → 0⁺): the gap keeps closing and never arrives; this is the default until a Koppel settles or flips. Faint lines add the noise term ε. The curves are shapes; no scale is implied. A crossing from one trajectory to another fires a Vonk: a Realisatie if it deepens the bond, a Schok if it tears energy away.
svg.text: §VI · §VIII.4 · THE SAME KOPPEL, OVER THE LIFE OF THE BOND
each panel: a stretch of one bond’s life
A = hi − hj, the gap between how much each side is currently reciprocating; Helling λ selects the regime.
Zweven is the default until a Koppel settles or flips; Trouw and Gewenning hold it, and its Greep resists the Van Motor.
A crossing from one trajectory to another fires a Vonk: a Realisatie (φ) if it deepens the bond,
a Schok (:) if it tears energy away. Faint lines add the noise term ε; the shapes carry no scale.
